phishing.title: Phishing & smishing
phishing.summary: Fake emails, SMS and websites that imitate banks or government bodies to steal your login details.

upi.title: UPI & QR code fraud
upi.summary: Tricks that make you approve a payment or scan a code while believing you are receiving money.

sim_swap.title: SIM swap & SIM-block calls
sim_swap.summary: Attackers take over your mobile number to intercept OTPs and reset your banking access.

remote_access.title: Fake customer care & remote access
remote_access.summary: Fraudsters posing as support staff persuade you to install screen-sharing apps.

digital_arrest.title: Digital arrest scam
digital_arrest.summary: Fraudsters pose as police, CBI, customs or courts on a video call and claim you are under arrest.

deepfake.title: Deepfake & voice-clone scams
deepfake.summary: AI-generated voices and videos imitate relatives, colleagues or officials to demand urgent money.

investment.title: Investment & trading scams
investment.summary: Fake stock, IPO and crypto platforms that show made-up profits until you deposit large sums.

jobs.title: Fake job & task scams
jobs.summary: Part-time offers that pay small amounts at first, then demand deposits to continue.

loan_apps.title: Instant loan app harassment
loan_apps.summary: Unregulated lending apps that access your contacts and threaten you to force repayment.

sextortion.title: Sextortion & blackmail
sextortion.summary: Fraudsters use intimate or morphed content to threaten you into paying.

account_takeover.title: WhatsApp & social account takeover
account_takeover.summary: Attackers hijack your account with a verification code, then ask your contacts for money.

shopping.title: Online shopping & marketplace fraud
shopping.summary: Fake stores, and fake buyers or sellers on classifieds who take your money and disappear.

courier.title: Courier & parcel scams
courier.summary: Fake delivery notices that push you to pay a small fee or install a malicious app.
